label: Переиспользовать рабочий Mac Mini transport в AHAP browser runner
description: Mac Mini50260DevTools gateway и штатный MacMiniChromeTransport живы. Raw-CDP-only launcher не должен блокировать reuse. Явная конфигурация существующего transport, pinned page/account, без fallback и новых bridge/dependencies. CI владеет native target preparation, этот leaf source-only.
acceptance: Runner явно выбирает существующий direct CDP или штатный MacMiniChromeTransport; fail closed без exact page/account, отсутствие скрытого fallback; focused tests, published owned commit и launch contract. Не выдавать source proof за native case.

progress_events.note: Owner directs source-only MacMiniChromeTransport selection and fresh-main scoped publication. Exact page and expected account scope required; native target belongs to CI and no browser messages.

Fresh-main scoped commit f9ec4647 published and read back remotely. Source launch contract and focused evidence complete. CI owns native target preparation; preserve exact scope/lease prerequisite before any browser action.

changes.result: Published QMACREUSE on fresh origin/main. Commit f9ec4647b9b71289d339d37e603114a46e1b3ab9 has parent 0fdd84c71332321fc8c652efcc7fc961aaa451c2 and contains only src/ahap-browser-runner.ts, tests/ahap-browser-runner.test.ts, acceptance/native/browser/launch-contract.md. Remote ls-remote and post-push fetch both read back f9ec4647. Runner now requires explicit AHAP_CHATGPT_TRANSPORT=mac-mini|direct-cdp; Mac Mini mode reuses MacMiniChromeTransport, and both modes require exact page ID + expected account scope. AHAP filters list_pages to that page and fails closed if absent; no transport/page fallback. Focused typecheck passed and runner tests passed 12/12 twice on fresh-main revisions. Evidence: evidence/QMACREUSE-20261107.md. CI worktree's independent transcript hunk remains untouched. Native browser acceptance, target selection, and messages were not run.
